title: GeoQuads — Daily
spoiler: Think old states, empires and breakups.
help: Find the 4 hidden categories. Each has 4 unique items.

groups.name: Once part of Yugoslavia
groups.fact: Yugoslavia was made up of six republics: Slovenia, Croatia, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Serbia, Montenegro and North Macedonia.

groups.name: Once part of the Soviet Union
groups.fact: When the Soviet Union dissolved in 1991, it split into 15 independent countries.

groups.name: Once part of British India
groups.fact: Burma was separated from British India in 1937, ten years before the rest was partitioned into India and Pakistan.

groups.name: Once a German colony (before 1914)
groups.fact: Germany lost all its colonies after World War I; Togo and Cameroon were split between France and Britain.
